reviews.text: Was highly delighted with the service we received Rebecca was so good would recommend anybody who wants a good vet to go to white cross

We recently switched to White Cross Vets after seeing the reviews and they couldn't be more accurate.

Our dog Chino is a loveable oaf, a bit of a handful and not every dogs cup of tea (much to his dismay!). He's very excitable and an absolute bulldozer and up until now the vets has always been a super stressful experience.

After booking our first appt I rang them up in advance an hour before to explain what he was like and they couldn't have put me more at ease, even assuring me they love bigger dogs! ❤️

At the actual consultation I don't think we've ever had a vet take the time to listen to us and also explain everything in the detail the vet at white cross did.

Im actually embarrassed I didn't ask the vets name to be able to give her a special mention here.

They have honestly turned our vet experience around, this practice is a 10/10 and I will be recommending to anyone else I know who could use their services.
Every person we've spoke to so far has been amazing. Francisco especially is so kind and gentle and I 100% will recommend to all friends and family

Rebecca and the team were fantastic with our Kitten, Blossoms first visit. They were caring, friendly and the clinic had a calming atmosphere. I would highly recommend to anyone looking for a vet practise.

Thank you so much, Elaine

From Team Stanningley

Betty my 13 year old golden retriever was suffering with her ears, Vet Rebecca walked me through all the treatment and Betty three weeks later is far more happy and her ears no longer bother her.  Highly recommend
My dog is very nervous and the vet was so calm and gentle with him. They explained everything in detail and took their time and didn’t rush us. Lovely experience even if my dog dragged me out.
Thank you Aimee!

Amazing service from all involved with my cat lexi's care.Consultations are not rushed everything explained and all options covered. A referral to an specialist orthopaedic surgeon was needed and I was helped by Francisco(vet) to choose the right one. I am grateful to everyone at White Cross Vets Stanningley for the care they have shown Lexi and the help they have given me.I would strongly recommend this practice. Thankyou.

Thank you to white cross vets for making our puppy’s first visit to the vet such a positive experience for her. The atmosphere was very calm and the staff were all friendly and professional. Feeling very reassured to have a great local vets.

Very friendly and welcoming staff.  Greeted my dog like she was known to them and was a regular attender(this was our first visit).
Waiting area was nice and cool, (it was a hot day) and it was empty so we could settle and not worry about Zaza getting stressed by other animals.  Area was very clean and the seating was comfy.
We were called in for our consultation and Zaza's eye pressure test.   The test was advised by the PDSA they do not have the equipment there so I came here and had it done privately.  The PDSA Leeds have no ophthalmic specialised vets advised that the eye be removed, obviously if needed then I would have agreed but after coming here and having the test done on both eyes we were given the results and told she would need to remain on the eye drops but didn't  need the eye removing at this stage.  What a relief!!  I was given a presciption to get the drops online or at my own chemist as it would be cheaper that getting them direct from the vets.  A vet that puts animal health before financial gain is definitely good in my view. Zaza will be coming for all her eye checkups here and I am bringing Zak her brother next week for a check up and 2nd opinion on a couple of lumps.
Would definitely recommend this practice to anyone.   The staff are friendly, very patient, (Zaza is not very tolerant of strangers even with sedation and the test involves touching her eyeball to get the readings), knowledgeable, caring and listen to the owners concerns.  Despite Zaza being feisty, she wasnt muzzled and ended up being picked up by the vet and taken to the nurse to assist with the test.  Zaza came back being carried quite happily by the vet.
Thank you for the time and patience with Zaza and for setting my mind and my daughter's mind at ease.  We are eternally grateful.

I recently moved to this area. I found this vet practice to be very welcoming. I only brought my elderly cat in for nail clipping but received an altogether exceptional meet with Giles. He fussed my cat to make her feel settled and recommended a point
Very clean vets and the staff were very helpful and friendly, will definitely use them again in the future.
Extremely friendly staff, who absolutely adore all the animals that come through the door, mine included.

Fantastic Practice and staff.
Everyone has gone out of their way to support my reactive, rescue – no request seems to be too much, and they immediately knew what to put in place so that we could get Ronnie to the surgery in the safest, calmest way.  Any treatment has been fully explained and priced so there are no nasty surprises.  The most important fact is that all the staff care about their patients and are very welcoming.  It took a few tries to get the right vet practice and I’m so glad we found you!
Francisco was fantastic wirh my nervous cavapoo Martha. Very kind, gentle, considerate and very informative.  Would highly recommend to everyone. Thankyou

Thank you so much!!

Team Stanningley
Really friendly and helpful

Moved our 11 year Spaniel Millie to WCS from our previous long term vets due to recent reduction in care and Service.  Francisco (Vet) was excellent, very thorough, very friendly, very knowledgeable and did not try to oversell. Highly recommend these vets for their personal and professional service.
Very satisfied with service and discussion vet, Francisco Mendes, very helpful and informative was kind and gentle

White cross vets have been amazing with my Daisy. I warned them that she's been really difficult at her old vets in the past, I've dealt with her handed back to me because they couldn't do anything with her and I had to help hold her down while she screamed in my ear. Which was very upsetting for me resulted in me reluctantly taking her back there and looking for other options, but other places weren't taking on new pets unfortunatly and I felt defeated. Then White Cross opened close by and they have made me feel like Daisy was as important as she is to me. Respected her boundaries and when she went in for a dental I was able to hand her off to the lady's arms without issue. It was such an important step for me and Daisy, to trust again <3 Thank you.
Very calm environment my cat was treated with love and care. The vet was really kind and explained everything .

White cross stanningley - I find the staff so helpful and caring. From making the call to visiting the vet.  Everyone is so kind, the vet we see is knowledgeable, understanding, kind and patient. They have a way of putting you at ease.
Very friendly a warm welcome on phone and in person would highly recommend

Thank you Jane, we appreciate the review!

Team Stanningley

I brought our cat to get some lumps checked out and was really impressed with the service! The vet (Miles) was great with her and was extremely thorough when doing the exam. He explained the possible causes and our options kindly and clearly, and I left feeling confident that we’d found the right place for Gelato’s care.
Took our golden oldie for his monthly injections for the first time to White Cross Vets. All the staff were friendly and super helpful. Very happy with the service.

I can’t thank White Cross Vets enough for the care and professionalism they showed yesterday with my dog, Angel.
She wasn’t herself at all — quiet, not eating, and clearly uncomfortable — and as you can imagine, that had me really worried. From the moment we arrived, the team made us feel reassured and taken seriously.
A special thank you to Dr Francisco, who was absolutely excellent. He took the time to properly assess Angel, asked the right questions, and explained everything clearly in a way that actually made sense. What stood out the most was how thorough and calm he was — you can tell he genuinely cares about the animals and wants to get to the root of the issue, not just rush through an appointment.
Angel is already doing better, and I’m really grateful for the level of care we received. Highly recommend White Cross Vets to anyone who wants a team that is knowledgeable, compassionate, and truly invested in your pet’s wellbeing.

Sadly had to have our king charles put to sleep today after 12 Years and 7 Months of her love and faithfulness first time I have used this vets and can't thank them enough for their  kindness and understanding at this sad time would highly recommend this practice

My cat Mj had to come to this amazing practice full of lovely, professional people and animal lovers. She had to have teeth removal done which was done amazingly and i was kept updated when she was out of surgery, we couldnt thank them enough for putting her needs first and they was met massively

Thank you to the team of vets and receptionists from me, Mj and the family

Thank you so much!

Team Stanningley
Super friendly staff

Amazing service, calm and professional staff and a clean and spacious practice. It was our first visit here with our anxious border collie for the annual booster. The nurse and the vet doc took a good care of us and helped through the process. Thanks a lot!
Friendly caring helpful vets really reasonable couldn’t recommend enough kept us up to date with dogs op progress and recovery  5*

I recently moved my dogs to White Cross Vets (Stanningley) and have been very happy with the care both myself and my dog have received. One of my dogs has a chronic illness that has been difficult to manage and I was very worried about her. Vet Francisco carried out a thorough examination and took the time to properly listen and address my concerns, which was very reassuring. We now have a clear plan in place for her care and I feel relieved and grateful knowing she’s in good hands.

The whole team are friendly and welcoming. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for attentive and compassionate veterinary care.

I moved to Whitecross vets about a year ago, first their Eccleshill practice and now their new Stannigley practice. All the staff have been brilliant. Stanningley practice is very impressive and has brilliant facilities. A special mention to my vet Francisco Mendes who goes the extra mile for his furry patients.

Thank you Scott!!

Team Stanningley

Vet was so lovely and profesional took time to explain everything the care for my dog was great and genuine and the kindness towards me  and my dog lovely, after using many vets over the years this is by far the best ! Thankyou.

Thanks so much Tom! 

Team Stanningley

I can't say enough about how good my experience of White Cross is. I have only been with them for a couple of months, but in that time they have been able to successfully identify a health issue with my cat that required surgery, of which my previous vets had been incredibly blase (and this wasn't something to be left). From the minute I rang and spoke to the lovely staff member on reception (who spent about 15 mins fully listening to what had happened at my prior vets and what I was looking for from them) every interaction I have had has been brilliant.
The whole team just feels like they genuinely care - and it's an added bonus that the surgery is brand new too. I love the thoughtful addition of photos of staff members with their pets on the walls, it always makes me smile. Even the fact that the vets answer the phone and clearly all work to support each other is impressive. Francisco and Rebecca particularly took time to understand my concerns and prepare me emotionally for what to expect with my cats surgery, and Miles has been excellent in dealing with his post-op care. The nursing team are also fantatsic. It has been night and day compared to what I received at my last vets, and has made me realise what was missing.
Friends and family who have seen or been with me at appointments have commented on how brilliant  and comprehensive the consultations were, and I can't agree more. Vets bills will always be high but I feel the monthly plan they offer is decent value for money in the given context.
At the end of the day all I want is the best possible care for my cat (and me!), and that's what I feel I am getting. If you are considering bringing your pet to this vet, then I would absolutely say to go for it.
Great as always, only thing is Chewie turns to go as soon as we go through the door lol.
From start to finish we felt like we mattered. So often you get forgotten about but here you and your pet are treated with such care. Really impressed with the team here and at the Eccleshill branch.
Whitecross Vets really care for Yorkshire pet.  Excellent in everyday.  The care taken is exemplary.
